# Poe2StashAccessor

[API index](../index)

Stash status shortcuts over the canonical stash UI element.

## IsAvailable

```typescript
IsAvailable: boolean;
```

True when the stash panel exists in the current UI tree.

## IsOpen

```typescript
IsOpen: boolean;
```

True when the stash panel is visible/open.

## TryGetPanelClientRect

```typescript
TryGetPanelClientRect: RectangleF | null;
```

Script projection of the stash rectangle. The native `RectangleF` form remains for Rust
UI consumers; BindGen owns the structural JS encoding.

## TotalStashes

```typescript
TotalStashes: number;
```

Number of stash tabs (EC2 `StashElement.TotalStashes`), or 0 when the stash is unavailable /
closed. Facade-level surface for the typed data the C# reaches via `Stash.Panel.TotalStashes`.

## VisibleStashIndex

```typescript
VisibleStashIndex: number;
```

Index of the currently visible stash tab (EC2 `StashElement.IndexVisibleStash`), or 0 when the
stash is unavailable / closed.
